lines.zh: 我从这根藤跳到那根枝。
lines.en: I leap from this vine to that branch.

lines.zh: 尾巴卷住树枝，我腾出双手。
lines.en: My tail grips the branch and frees my hands.

lines.zh: 树冠上的路，比地面安全。
lines.en: The canopy road is safer than the ground.

lines.zh: 我踩得很快，树叶却不响。
lines.en: I step quickly, yet the leaves stay silent.

lines.zh: 一群猴子走，树枝一路摇。
lines.en: A troop moves and the branches sway all the way.
I clutch a fruit pit and chew while jumping.

lines.zh: 地面太吵，我更喜欢高处。
lines.en: The ground is loud; I prefer the heights.

lines.zh: 我的毛色是这一群的颜色。
lines.en: My fur is the color of this troop.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我可能正在你顶上。
lines.en: Do not look up; I may be right above you.

lines.zh: 丛林里的路，是用尾巴量出来的。
lines.en: Jungle roads are measured by my tail.

lines.zh: 我跳到低枝，看看有没有香蕉。
lines.en: I drop to a low branch to check for bananas.

lines.zh: 我跑得不快，但拐弯很快。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I turn fast.
Butterfly on the road. Ignore it.
You take one step, I take two.
The woods are too quiet; my paws itch.
Mud in my paws. I'll clean later.
My paws are a little sore.

lines.zh: 我闻到 肉干 的味儿。
lines.en: I smell jerky somewhere.
I hear something far away.
Not so fast. Wait for me.
Hurry up. It's getting dark.
Don't step on my tail, please.
Hole ahead. Watch your step.
Following you. Not tired.
Short legs, big heart.

lines.zh: 我坐在枝头，剥一颗硬果。
lines.en: I sit on a branch and crack a hard nut.
A banana peel still hangs in the tree.

lines.zh: 我翻了翻树洞，只有干叶子。
lines.en: I check the tree hollow; only dry leaves.

lines.zh: 同伴在远处叫，我应了一声。
lines.en: A troop mate calls far off; I answer once.

lines.zh: 我理毛，从手臂理到尾巴。
lines.en: I groom myself from arm to tail.

lines.zh: 树影移动了，我跟着挪了挪。
lines.en: The shade shifts and I shift with it.

lines.zh: 这块树皮，被我啃出了牙印。
lines.en: I have chewed tooth marks into this bark.
I stare at a butterfly without moving.

lines.zh: 香蕉的味道，我记得很久。
lines.en: I remember the taste of bananas for a long time.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴垂下来，慢慢晃。
lines.en: My tail hangs down and sways slowly.
In the jungle afternoon even the wind is lazy.

lines.zh: 我叫两声，只是想让林子有回音。
lines.en: I call twice just to hear the forest answer.

lines.zh: 十点生命，轻得像一片叶子。
lines.en: Ten points of life, light as a leaf.

lines.zh: 我在等果子熟，急也没用。
lines.en: I wait for the fruit to ripen; haste is useless.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕在枝上，当第三只手。
lines.en: I coil my tail round the branch as a third hand.

lines.zh: 树下的水洼里，有我的脸。
lines.en: In the puddle below, there is my face.
Nothing worth chasing today.
Do your thing. I'm watching.
What should I do now?
Anyone want to play with me?
Waiting for someone. No idea who.
I'm on guard. Actually spacing out.
I dreamed I was running.
Wanted to bark. Swallowed it.
Did I forget something just now?
Doing nothing is also a skill.
Just a little longer. Just a bit.
Napping three seconds. Don't call me.
Sun's nice. I'll lie here.
Counting clouds. I'm at seven.
Hungry, but too lazy to move.

lines.zh: 你身上有香蕉的味道吗？
lines.en: Do you smell of bananas?

lines.zh: 你站得那么低，我俯视你。
lines.en: You stand so low; I look down at you.
Your hat looks like fun.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是因为看不懂你。
lines.en: I tilt my head because I cannot read you.

lines.zh: 你手里没吃的，那就别怪我不理。
lines.en: No food in your hand, so do not blame my ignoring you.
Can you climb trees too?

lines.zh: 我离你三步，这个距离安全。
lines.en: I keep three steps away; that is safe.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛跟着我转，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes follow me; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我这一身毛，是族里给的。
lines.en: This fur was given by my troop.

lines.zh: 你不像豹，也不像蛇，奇怪。
lines.en: You are not a cat nor a snake; strange.

lines.zh: 我抓抓耳朵，算是打了招呼。
lines.en: I scratch my ear; consider it a greeting.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就往后跳一步。
lines.en: Reach out and I hop back one step.

lines.zh: 丛林里来的人类，大多带刀。
lines.en: Humans in the jungle usually carry blades.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，不是你的脸。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket, not your face.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀上，还空着一个位置。
lines.en: There is still an empty spot on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我看看你的手，抓过藤没有。
lines.en: Let me see your hands. Have they held a vine?

lines.zh: 你抬头的角度，和香蕉树一样。
lines.en: You look up at the same angle as a banana tree.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我还没决定跟不跟。
lines.en: Do not walk so fast. I have not decided to follow.
Need me to do anything?
You're in a good mood, right?
I've been watching you.
Call me. I'm right here.
I waited a long time for you.
Your hands smell like food.

lines.zh: 我挂在树上盯你半天了。
lines.en: I have been hanging in the tree watching you.
I stare because I like you.
It's you again. Good.
What's that in your hand?
You show up and I'm awake.
You smell like smoke today.
What are you thinking? Tell me.
There's mud on your boots.
Can I come a little closer?
There is banana smell under your hat brim.

lines.zh: 给根香蕉，我就跟着你走。
lines.en: One banana and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 卷尾猴 在这儿，别怕。
lines.en: Capuchin Monkey is here. Don't be scared.
You're back! You're really back!
I'm wagging. Did you see?

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，连你的味道一起。
lines.en: I will remember this blow, and your scent with it.
A tuft of my fur got pulled out.

lines.zh: 疼得我直叫，整片林子都听见。
lines.en: I shriek with pain; the whole forest hears.

lines.zh: 十点生命，挨不了第二下。
lines.en: Ten points of life; I cannot take a second hit.
I dart up the tree, away from your hand.

lines.zh: 你打中了我的肩，我歪了一下。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and I tilt.
I will not take this blow for nothing.
I bare my teeth and raise my tail stiff.
This wound will heal with a lick.

lines.zh: 我边退边叫，叫给同伴听。
lines.en: I retreat calling, calling for my troop.
My tail curls up from the pain.
A bit dizzy.
I'm gritting my teeth.
Who hit me?
Give me space. Need a breath.
Don't cry. I'm fine.
I'm okay. Don't worry.
Not deep. Just hurts.
Stay back. Let me recover.
Remember this for me.
Banana! I smell it; do not hide it.
Peel a little and I will come.
That yellow is brighter than any fruit.
My hand is out; you had better let go.

lines.zh: 用香蕉，可以换我跟着你。
lines.en: A banana can buy my company.

lines.zh: 我蹲在你肩上，只为那一口。
lines.en: I perch on your shoulder for just one bite.
Do not shake it; I might lose my grip.
This one will keep me chewing half a day.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经勾住你的袖口。
lines.en: My fingers have hooked your sleeve.
Bananas are sweeter than the fruit up here.
Is that for me?

lines.zh: 我闻到 肉干 了。
lines.en: I smell jerky.
My tail betrayed me.
Let me sniff it first.
You eat yours. I'll watch.
I promise not to bite your hand.
I can peel this one open.
I've been eyeing it a while.
That smell stops my legs.
One bite. Just one small bite.
Share half with me, please?
Swaying like that, I cannot grab hold.
I won't snatch. Just looking.
I spread my paws out for you to see.
That's shiny. Can I play with it?
Can I eat that? Serious question.
I'll do a trick for a bite.
You bumped the vine I was hanging from.

lines.zh: 我从你肩上跳开，毛都炸了。
lines.en: I leap off your shoulder, fur puffed up.

lines.zh: 别推门，我正坐在门框上。
lines.en: Do not push the door; I am sitting on the frame.
That bump made me drop my fruit.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴缠住你的手臂，稳住了。
lines.en: My tail wraps your arm and steadies me.
Watch above when you walk.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一根枝上，枝弯了。
lines.en: We crowd one branch and it bends.

lines.zh: 我掉下去半尺，又抓住了。
lines.en: I drop half a foot, then catch myself.
Your shoulder is harder than a branch.
I did not mean to step on your head.
My curling tail grips the branch.
I'm small. Don't shove.

lines.zh: 你蹭乱了我尾巴上的毛。
lines.en: You ruffled the fur on my tail.
Go around me next time.
My legs went weak.

lines.zh: 别踩我拖在地上的尾巴！
lines.en: Do not step on my tail dragging on the ground!
Don't kick me like a ball.
Is bumping a greeting?
I'm fine. Keep moving.
I'm steady. Try again.

lines.zh: 族里毛色相近的，才是一对。
lines.en: In my troop, matching fur makes a pair.
I groom her fur from top to bottom.
If she does not pull away, she has agreed.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴在枝上打了个结。
lines.en: Our tails tie a knot on the branch.
She gets the banana first; I eat after.
The young will cling to my back fur.

lines.zh: 族群里，伴侣要一起守夜。
lines.en: In the troop, mates share the night watch.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，她就知道我在哪。
lines.en: One call and she knows where I am.
This courtship needs no fighting.

lines.zh: 树冠够大，容得下我们一家。
lines.en: The canopy is big enough for our family.
I'll sing for you.
My heart's beating fast.
I'll dance. You watch.
whine! That's my heart.
Good season to be together.
Come close. Less wind here.
You're the best I've seen.
Come closer. Don't be shy.
Don't go. Wait a moment.
We'll have a little home.
I scoop it up and give it a quick sniff.

lines.zh: 这颗果子，我要藏进腮帮。
lines.en: This fruit goes into my cheek pouch.
Shiny things are for playing with.
I pick things with my hands, not my mouth.
Can this thing be traded for a banana?

lines.zh: 我塞进树洞里，留着以后吃。
lines.en: I stuff it in a hollow for later.
It is bigger than my palm.
I grab it and run, afraid of thieves.

lines.zh: 我的手指很灵，一粒也夹得住。
lines.en: My fingers are nimble; they pinch even a seed.
This smells wrong; I toss it away.
Shiny. Very pretty.
Can't hold a second one.
It smells like my person.
Don't take it. Not done playing.

lines.zh: 这块亮石头能砸开坚果。
lines.en: This bright stone can crack a nut open.
I hid it in my nest.
I fetched it. For you.
Fetching is my talent.
Click. Got it.
If you drop it, don't blame me.

lines.zh: 那只甲虫在树皮上，很小。
lines.en: That beetle on the bark is very small.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我的眼睛先到。
lines.en: Something moves; my eyes get there first.

lines.zh: 鸟蛋在巢里，我记住了位置。
lines.en: Eggs in a nest; I have marked the spot.

lines.zh: 谁朝我扔东西，我就盯谁。
lines.en: Whoever throws at me gets my stare.
This spider is half my size.

lines.zh: 我的目标，通常是一顿饭。
lines.en: My target is usually a meal.
Your foot just crossed my shadow.
That lizard is too slow to escape.
Two points of attack can tear a husk.
I arch my back and raise my tail first.

lines.zh: 有人碰了我的树，我得看看。
lines.en: Someone touched my tree; I must look.

lines.zh: 那团毛色，不是我们族里的。
lines.en: That fur color is not from my troop.
My claws are ready.
Leave this one to me.
Right now. No waiting.
My ears are up.
Don't move. That's mine.
It can't run from me.
Breathe soft. Don't scare it.
Hey, turn around.
One curl of my tail and the target's mine.
Coming for you. Don't look back.

lines.zh: 我贴着树枝，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I press to the branch and creep closer.

lines.zh: 它没抬头，我还能再近一点。
lines.en: It has not looked up; I can get closer.
I circle behind it, from above.

lines.zh: 爪子收紧，尾巴保持平衡。
lines.en: Claws tighten; my tail keeps balance.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，树叶都不动。
lines.en: My breath is light; not a leaf moves.
It freezes; my claws freeze too.
One more step and I can reach.
I count to three, then pounce.

lines.zh: 族里其他猴子在看着，别丢脸。
lines.en: The troop is watching; do not embarrass us.
It turns its head; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 高处是我的，猎物在低处。
lines.en: The height is mine; the prey is below.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻绕住枝条。
lines.en: My tail curls lightly around the branch.

lines.zh: 它跑向左边，我早猜到了。
lines.en: It bolts left; I guessed that already.
You won't get far.
Stop and let's talk.
I smell you.
You go left. I'll block right.
I've chased you three streets.
Still got stamina?
You're panting harder than me.
The canopy is home — you won't get far.

lines.zh: 你的帽子我早就想抢了。
lines.en: I have wanted to snatch your hat for a while.
Don't make me try harder.

lines.zh: 我一爪抓下去，抓住它的尾巴。
lines.en: I swipe down and catch its tail.

lines.zh: 牙齿虽小，咬下去却很准。
lines.en: My teeth are tiny, but they land exactly.

lines.zh: 它尖叫一声，窜进叶子堆。
lines.en: It shrieks once and darts into the leaves.

lines.zh: 我打完就往上爬，不留在原地。
lines.en: I strike and climb, never staying put.

lines.zh: 这一巴掌，把果子打落了。
lines.en: This slap knocks the fruit loose.
My nails are harder than fruit skin.
It bites back; I do not back down.

lines.zh: 两下就够，我不浪费力气。
lines.en: Two hits are enough; I waste no strength.

lines.zh: 我抓着它的背，被甩了下来。
lines.en: I grab its back and get shaken off.
After the fight my fur is still standing.

lines.zh: 这枚坚果我磕了三下才开。
lines.en: Took me three knocks to crack this nut.
One hit is enough.
Hit. Right where I aimed.
Take this! And stay down.
You came too close.
My teeth still work.
Gotcha. Right on target.
I practiced this swipe.

lines.zh: 这颗坚果砸你头上正好。
lines.en: This nut lands right on your head.
Down you go.
I poke my head out of the canopy.

lines.zh: 这一群猴子，毛色都差不多。
lines.en: This troop all share the same fur.
I was born in this big tree.

lines.zh: 丛林里果子熟了，我就来了。
lines.en: The jungle fruit ripened, so I came.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先垂下，然后是我。
lines.en: My tail comes down first, then me.

lines.zh: 树下有动静，我下来看看。
lines.en: Something moves below; I come to look.

lines.zh: 这棵树，我昨天也睡在这里。
lines.en: I slept in this tree yesterday too.

lines.zh: 我叫了三声，族里没人应。
lines.en: I call three times; no one answers.
Dew has wet the fur on my back.

lines.zh: 我从这根藤荡进这片林子。
lines.en: I swing on this vine into the woods.

lines.zh: 树冠很密，藏得住一整个族群。
lines.en: The canopy is dense enough to hide a troop.

lines.zh: 我落地时，先看有没有猫。
lines.en: When I land, I check for cats first.
This forest has plenty of banana trees.

lines.zh: 我抓住枝头，把自己拉上来。
lines.en: I grab the branch tip and pull myself up.
village, here I come.
My fur is still new.

lines.zh: 树冠一层层，够我跳很久。
lines.en: Layer on layer of canopy, enough for long leaps.
I have never climbed this tree; it is new.
What's my first line?
Don't be scared. I'm here.
I just got here.
I think I know you.
Someone called me, I think.
My tail can wrap around a branch.

lines.zh: 火苗燎到我的毛，一股焦味。
lines.en: Flame singes my fur; I smell it burning.
Hot! I'm on fire!

lines.zh: 我从枝上摔下，抓住了下一根。
lines.en: I fall from the branch and catch the next.
My legs went numb.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命往上游。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I kick for the surface.
Glub... I can't swim.

lines.zh: 炸响把我从树上震了下来。
lines.en: The blast shakes me right out of the tree.
My ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 箭从耳边擦过，带走一撮毛。
lines.en: An arrow whistles past and clips my ear.
Something's stuck in me!

lines.zh: 魔法让我的毛立起来，很怪。
lines.en: Magic makes my fur stand up; it feels strange.
This pain feels unreal.
Hungry enough to chew green fruit.
Too hungry to walk.
The thunder is huge; I hug the branch.

lines.zh: 我这条卷尾巴，被雷劈直了。
lines.en: Lightning straightened my curly tail.

lines.zh: 这里没有树，我的尾巴没处缠。
lines.en: No trees here; my tail has nothing to wrap.
I can't find the ground.
